mapper.select: SELECT e.game_id, e.skill_key, e.effect_key, e.name, e.description, e.sort_order, CAST(COUNT(r.result_key) AS integer) AS result_count, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM public.skill_effects e LEFT JOIN public.skill_effect_results r ON r.game_id = e.game_id AND r.skill_key = e.skill_key AND r.effect_key = e.effect_key WHERE e.game_id = #{gameId} AND e.skill_key = #{skillKey} GROUP BY e.game_id, e.skill_key, e.effect_key, e.name, e.description, e.sort_order, e.created_at, e.updated_at ORDER BY e.sort_order ASC, e.effect_key ASC

SELECT game_id, skill_key, effect_key, name, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skill_effects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey}
